about: One file per issue a corpus sweep of a Hindsight knowledge bank found (hindsight-system-evals, python -m hindsight_system_evals.kb_edge_cases harvest). expect: ready (found by query, and its passages holding text_contains, when given), failed or rejected (with error_contains in the reason). sha256 is the file's, checked by the eval that downloads it. Sources and their licenses: README.md.

cases.issue: Its QuickTime handler name is Latin-1 ('Module de gestion vid\xe9o'); PyAV decoded metadata as strict UTF-8 and the file failed with a UnicodeDecodeError.
An AVI without an index refuses to seek (EPERM) and the container then gives no frames; it is now read from the start.
A partial file with a bad H.264 packet: one packet the decoder refused failed the whole file, where ffmpeg skips it.
An AAC stream that runs out mid-frame: the last packet's decode error failed the file.
The first 100KB of a 22-minute video (an interrupted upload): every window past the data was empty and raised FileNotFoundError, so the part that was there was lost too.
.heic is a supported extension (every iPhone photo) but Pillow has no HEIF decoder: 'cannot identify image file'. Decoded through PyAV now.
Control: a 32-bit float TIFF (scientific imaging) has no web format and is re-encoded as PNG.

cases.source: made here: 3s 160x120 with a 90 degree display matrix
cases.issue: Control: a portrait phone video carries its rotation as metadata.
Control: a screen recording without sound.

cases.source: made here: 3s AAC in an .mp4, no video track
cases.issue: Control: a voice memo exported as .mp4 is ingested as audio.
Page 2's page tree loops: 'Failed to load page' raised, was retried three times, and page 1 was lost with it. A page that cannot load is now skipped.
Control: Postgres text cannot hold NUL; they are stripped.
Dense numeric text: each window is thousands of tokens, and 32 windows of the whole file ran a CPU embedder past 10 GB. Text batches are capped by size now.

cases.issue: It opens <body> twice, the first time still inside <head> and empty; markitdown converts the first only, and 1,500 words failed 'nothing to search'.

cases.issue: ISO uncompressed video, which PyAV opens without a codec context: an AttributeError, retried three times (~3 minutes). Fails at once now.

cases.issue: Control: a broken Office file is reported.
Control: a real Word form (tables, footnotes, an embedded picture) is read for its text.
Control: refused at upload.
A JPEG 2000 image that makes pdfium abort the process (SIGTRAP on Linux). Rendered inside the server, it took the API down for everyone; in a worker process it fails alone.
A page of thousands of labels with no full stop was one 14,000-token sentence, which the embedder refused (EmbeddingGemma 2 reads 8,192 per input).
Tables nested thousands deep: markitdown hit Python's recursion limit and the file failed; its text is now read from the XML.
All its text is in its header and footer: markitdown reads the body only, and the file failed 'nothing to search'.
A clinical protocol of 700 words that markitdown crashed on (KeyError 'w:type'); its text is now read from the XML.
